description.value:
Trandoshans are a reptilian, scaled humanoid species from the jungle world of Trandosha, sworn enemies of the Wookiees of neighboring Kashyyyk. Trandoshan religion venerates the Scorekeeper, a mythic figure said to tally the worth of every kill and capture made in life, driving many Trandoshans toward careers as hunters, bounty hunters, and mercenaries.

A Trandoshan's scaled hide regenerates readily from injury, and even severed limbs can regrow over time — a resilience that serves them well in their dangerous trade.

traits.name: Claws
traits.description: Your claws are natural weapons. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Regenerative Vigor
traits.description: When you finish a short rest and spend at least one Hit Die to regain hit points, you regain additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

traits.name: Hunter's Instinct
traits.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track a creature that is below its hit point maximum.
